summary: Hookups (50 A + water), count 102 and max 45 ft now manual from ReserveAmerica; booking platform corrected operator -> reserveamerica. Fees already match the McConaughy grid and the saved 2027 quotes ($10 off-season, $15/$20 basic). Waterfront lead DOWN, lakefront -> lakeview. Not a sand-rule drop. Pin ~320 m from the loops' centre.
flags: SAND RULE: the RV campground stays. ReserveAmerica gives 'Driveway Surface: Paved' for 97 of the 102 Cedar View sites (the other 5 list no surface), on paved loops in pine and cedar. The open beach camping is a separate RA unit, 'Cedar View Beach' (one 'Nonspecific+' Primitive unit), on the sand below the bench. A developed loop that also offers beach camping stays; the beach unit itself is a sand-driving area.

WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview): the pads sit on a vegetated bench at 998-1002 m (3DEP: site 013 1001.6, 040 1001.5, 044 1001.1, 055 1001.7, 062 998.8, 101 998.1). Below them a 6-8 m slope drops to the sand beach: south of site 040 the DEM reads 1001.3 m at 41.2922, then 993.0 at 41.2920 and 990.3 at 41.2915, reaching the flattened water surface of 988.2 m at ~41.2912. Today's water on NAIP and Esri is ~150-400 m away across open sand, the beach-camping area, with exposed flats and the North Platte channel at this west end. Full pool (3,265 ft, ~995 m) would put the waterline ~20-30 m below the south row (040-046) and ~60-70 m below the west row (099-102), but still at the foot of the bank, and the strip between is the used beach-camping area. Either way this is a bench above the water with a used strip between, so it does not earn on-water. Some pads look over open sand to the lake, so lakeview stands. The stored evidence is only the 2026-06 sweep commit pointer. (The NIR water-mask distances of 23-250 m picked up shadow, not water, and are not used.)
PIN (move proposed): stored 41.29258,-101.93461 is at site 013 at the east end of the campground, ~320 m from the centre of the 102 RA site points. Suggest 41.2940,-101.9380.

FEES: no change. The stored low $10 (Basic, September 13 - May 20) and high $15 (Basic Sunday-Wednesday in season) with a $5 Thursday-Saturday surcharge and a $15 electric add-on match the McConaughy grid and the saved 6/15 and 6/19/2027 quotes. Basic sites are 45 ft, so EKKO fits the base type. Their provenance carries no method (built by ne_build.py).
